verdict.rationale: Foreloop ships an official global npm CLI (`npm i -g foreloop`) that manages projects, loops, intentions, stories and tasks, supports `--json` for scripting/agent consumption, and is explicitly designed to be runnable by 'anything that can run one, including coding agents and cron,' plus `foreloop init` wires an agent skill into a checkout. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs, and no detail on CLI command coverage or versioning history.
